papers.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
papers.summary: IdeaTaste benchmarks LLM research proposals against future publications, revealing that AI agents match human communities in broad directions but fall far behind in concrete approaches and expected success.
papers.organization: Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 41 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.summary: ToolSpace constructs realistic multi-environment tool-use benchmarks by mining execution traces, clustering tool compositions, and validating tasks through replayable state-aware random walks.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 33 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
papers.summary: VidUEU-Agent automates instruction data synthesis from raw videos via a multi-stage pipeline with autonomous iteration, yielding a 100K-sample dataset that improves multimodal model performance.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 23 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: YANAMI: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Multiturn Stateful Interaction
papers.summary: YANAMI introduces a large-scale multimodal dialogue dataset and benchmark for stateful interaction, requiring models to track and realize evolving dialogue states across turns, and reveals that current unified multimodal models still struggle with this task.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 26 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy
papers.summary: MoviEdit is an end-to-end framework for long-form multi-shot video editing that uses cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive modeling and a new benchmark to maintain coherence across scenes while reducing manual data annotation.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 60 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: Words Caught in the Heart: Simulating Person-Specific Expression for Self-Opaque Clients in Psychotherapy
papers.summary: Pandora is a psychotherapy client simulation framework that models evolving psychological and relational states to generate more authentic, individually aligned expressions and reduce AI-like responses.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 66 upvotes no Hugging Face.
